supportingOcamlLibrarySourceBuildFollowU.bytesCompatibilityNativeControlScript:
set -eu
cd /work/bytes-compat-controls
: > results.tsv
for runtime in bytecode native; do
  if [ "$runtime" = bytecode ]; then compiler=/work/install/bin/ocamlc; else compiler=/work/install/bin/ocamlopt; fi
  for variant in baseline lowbit-mutant bounds-mutant restored; do
    "$compiler" -o "$variant-$runtime" "$variant.ml" > "$variant-$runtime-compile.log" 2>&1
    if timeout --kill-after=5s 30s "./$variant-$runtime" > "$variant-$runtime-run.log" 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
    case "$variant" in
      baseline|restored) test "$code" = 0; grep -Fxq 'cases=47' "$variant-$runtime-run.log";;
      lowbit-mutant) test "$code" = 2; grep -Fq 'written byte mismatch' "$variant-$runtime-run.log";;
      bounds-mutant) test "$code" = 2; grep -Fq 'invalid index was accepted' "$variant-$runtime-run.log";;
    esac
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$runtime" "$variant" "$code" >> results.tsv
  done
done
